# TWD (Test While Developing)

> TWD runs frontend tests in the browser you develop in: a sidebar in your dev server runs component and flow tests against your real app, with API boundaries mocked by a service worker. AI agents write, run and fix those tests headlessly with twd-cli, and the same runner handles CI, pull-request video recordings and OpenAPI contract validation. Works with React, Vue, Angular, Solid, Astro, Nuxt, HTMX and vanilla JS, on Vite, Webpack or a CDN.

Full documentation as a single file: https://twd.dev/llms-full.txt

How it fits together:
- twd-js: the sidebar and test API. Tests live in your app and run against its real routes, providers and component tree.
- twd-ai: skills for AI agents. Claude Code plugin (`claude plugin install twd@twd-ai`) or any agent via `npx skills add BRIKEV/twd-ai`. The agent probes the dev server, writes tests, runs them with twd-cli, fixes failures and closes with a full-suite run.
- twd-cli: the headless runner. The agent loop, CI, sharding, coverage, `--record` video clips and contract validation all use it. Only the dev server has to be running.
- twd-relay (optional): watch an agent's test runs live in your own browser tab.

Key features:
- In-browser test execution with a sidebar UI, against the real app
- API mocking via a built-in service worker; component and module mocking
- Testing Library queries, and component tests via Testing Library render() in the same session
- Token-efficient agent loop: one structured summary per run, no screenshots, no Playwright
- CI with twd-cli: coverage, sharding, layout snapshots (beta)
- Pull-request recordings: label a PR `record`, get one video per test the branch added
- Contract testing: every mock validated against your OpenAPI spec

## Core Concepts

- [Getting Started](https://twd.dev/getting-started): Installation, setup (bundled vs standard), first test, troubleshooting
- [Writing Tests](https://twd.dev/writing-tests): Test structure, element selection (TWD native + Testing Library), assertions, user interactions, navigation
- [API Mocking](https://twd.dev/api-mocking): Service worker setup, request mocking patterns, dynamic responses, error handling
- [Component Testing](https://twd.dev/component-testing): Render a single component with Testing Library in a real browser, and choosing between component and flow tests
- [Component Mocking](https://twd.dev/component-mocking): MockedComponent wrapper, conditional mocking, error states
- [Module Mocking](https://twd.dev/module-mocking): Sinon-based module mocking for ESM
- [Theming](https://twd.dev/theming): Customizing the TWD sidebar
- [CI Execution](https://twd.dev/ci-execution): twd-cli setup, filtering with --test and --changed-since, GitHub Actions
- [Recording Runs](https://twd.dev/recording): Record tests to video with twd-cli, and the record action for pull requests
- [Coverage](https://twd.dev/coverage): Code coverage reporting
- [Contract Testing Setup](https://twd.dev/contract-testing-setup): OpenAPI validation setup, contract options, supported validations, PR reports
- [Framework Integration](https://twd.dev/frameworks): React, Vue, Angular, Solid, Astro, React Router, Nuxt, CRA, HTMX and vanilla JS setup
- [Testing Library](https://twd.dev/testing-library): Testing Library integration and selectors
- [Sharding](https://twd.dev/sharding): Split a long run across parallel CI jobs with --shard and twd-cli merge (beta)
- [Layout Snapshots](https://twd.dev/layout-snapshots): Catch layout regressions with twd.matchLayout, an in-browser geometry snapshot (beta)

## AI agents

- [Get started with AI agents](https://twd.dev/ai-overview): Install the skills (Claude Code plugin or npx skills add), run /twd:setup, ask for tests, add CI
- [Project Setup](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/setup): /twd:setup installs twd-js and twd-cli, wires the Vite plugin, writes twd.config.json and .claude/twd-patterns.md
- [Writing & Running Tests](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/writing-tests): The headless loop — probe, scoped run, fix, branch check, full suite, recording offer
- [CI Setup](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/ci-setup): /twd:ci-setup generates GitHub Actions workflows with coverage, contract validation and PR recordings
- [Test Gap Analysis](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/test-gaps): Find untested routes and classify risk with /twd:test-gaps
- [Test Quality](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/test-quality): Grade test quality across four dimensions with /twd:test-quality
- [Test Flow Gallery](https://twd.dev/twd-ai/flow-gallery): Generate visual flowcharts of test coverage with /twd:test-flow-gallery
- [Watch Your Agent Live](https://twd.dev/ai-remote-testing): Optional twd-relay setup to see the agent's runs in your own browser tab
- [Context & Prompts](https://twd.dev/agents): A TWD context prompt for tools without skills support

## Philosophy

- [TWD Manifesto](https://twd.dev/twd-manifesto): Core principles — test while building, test what you own, mock what you don't
- [Why Test While Developing](https://twd.dev/motivation): Motivation, philosophy, and what changes in the AI era
